description: This file defines the 'jjwg_Markers' class, which extends 'jjwg_Markers_sugar' and manages marker location logic within the SuiteCRM module. It includes methods for configuration, location definition, and coordinate validation.

classes.name: jjwg_Markers
classes.description: A class managing map marker locations, configuration, and validation within the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the jjwg_Markers object and loads configuration if specified.

methods.name: configuration
methods.description: Loads map configuration settings using the related Maps module.

methods.name: define_loc
methods.description: Defines a marker location, returning its name, coordinates, and image, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: is_valid_lng
methods.description: Checks if a longitude value is numeric and within valid range (-180 to 180).

methods.name: is_valid_lat
methods.description: Checks if a latitude value is numeric and within valid range (-90 to 90).
